one_liner: Sherlock (sherlock-project) is a local open-source Python CLI for username enumeration across sites; it has no hosted HTTP API or credentials, so it can't become a standard hosted-API toolkit.
auth_notes: The fetched repo page shows a local CLI with no login or key options. Other products named Sherlock (audit engine, Sherlock Calls) are unrelated.
access_notes: The MIT-licensed CLI installs for free with pipx, pip, or Docker, with no account. There is no vendor-hosted service to get credentials for.
blocker_notes: It is a local CLI with no hosted API. A toolkit would have to run the CLI itself. The community MCP wrapper could not be verified from the fetched pages. The vendor-namespace MCP registry search found nothing.

evidence.quote: Accounts found will be stored in an individual text file with the corresponding username
| `pipx install sherlock-project` | `pip` or [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) may be used in place of `pipx` |
